List of challenge KPIs and how the project addressed them
・stay up to date with db-sync structure changes - there was not structure finalised on first sachno release, but we worked on implementation and changes implementations since sanchoV1 to recent
・correctly handle CIP-68 integration and NFT metadata changes
・working and stable website - this is a never-ending battle - keeping up with the increasing size of the blockchain by the minute - we solve by constant optimizations and increasing hw 

List of project KPIs and how the project addressed them
・stable website and page load - optimalization of queries, caching, hw improvement (evidence)
・sancho features - a lot of changes and updates on dev side (evidence)
・provide explorer for all enviroments - this is sometimes complicated stay up to date for all instances, but we have solved this perfectly with devops. (evidence + sancho up and running)
・note: in general, the KPIs for our catalyst - Explorer maintenance, are not quite right in this case. So the primary goal is a functional site that supports the latest features (evidence)
